reason: As someone who got burned before, seeing the actual factory quote and shipping costs in Document B would actually make me pause—because 570 backers paying $49 with shipping included leaves huge gaps for platform fees, freight, and fulfillment, making me worry the creator undercalculated. Document A catches that financial trap with a helpful prompt, paints a much better picture of the game, and handles the small sample size of ratings with disarming honesty.
